title: The changed supplier bank account — question explanation
learningObjective: Independently verify changed payment instructions using a known contact method
format: 16:9 educational motion-graphics video; narration; separate captions; no autoplay with sound
visualStyle: Deep navy and charcoal; restrained cyan/electric-blue highlights; limited purple accents; clean typography; purposeful, low-motion transitions; accessible contrast.

scenes.name: Scenario setup
scenes.visual: A regular supplier emails an updated invoice with new bank details and says payment must be made today to avoid a penalty.
scenes.direction: Show a fictional simulated setting. Use generic UI and no actual organization, brand, user identity, credential, real URL or live account.

scenes.name: Learning objective and risk cue
scenes.visual: Independently verify changed payment instructions using a known contact method
scenes.direction: Highlight only observable cues and explain the decision context without implying certainty beyond the scenario.

scenes.name: Recommended response
scenes.visual: Option D: Verify the change through a separately established phone number or approved vendor portal and follow dual-approval controls. Payment changes need independent verification through trusted records and the normal authorization process.
scenes.direction: Animate the recommended defensive choice as a clear decision path. Display the action verb and trusted channel/control.

scenes.name: Why the other options fail
scenes.visual: Option A: The email may provide an attacker-controlled number; use contact details already on file. Option B: If the account is compromised, the attacker may confirm their own fraudulent instructions. Option C: A test payment still sends funds to an unverified beneficiary and can create loss.
scenes.direction: Show each unsafe alternative separately with a complete, concise reason. Do not depict operational exploitation, malicious code or credential capture.

scenes.name: Defensive takeaway
scenes.visual: Freeze the change until independently verified using contact information already on file, and apply the organization’s payment authorization controls. Never trust changed payment instructions solely because they arrive in a familiar email thread.
scenes.direction: Close with one readable takeaway and the next safe action. Keep the final frame long enough for comprehension.
scenes.onScreenText: Never trust changed payment instructions solely because they arrive in a familiar email thread.
